ownerApproval.scope: Alternative C, all 18 compatibility decisions, permanent historical reads, non-lossy split and merge rules, user re-approval, adapter removal criteria, and the four new canonical section policies.

inventory.scope: This matrix covers only the 18 conflicts; the future ledger remains responsible for all 86 enhanced profiles.

approvedAuthority.decision: Owner-approved architecture: use one immutable versioned ledger and adopt richer Enhanced DIP sections as candidate canonical keys under the approved non-lossy mappings.
approvedAuthority.historicalReadPolicy: Catalogue keys remain permanent historical identities while referenced.
approvedAuthority.newWritePolicy: No proposed key enters live generation until an immutable version, persistence boundary and adapter exist.
approvedAuthority.userContentPolicy: Never silently discard, model-redistribute or auto-approve historical content.

catalogueScope.policy: The immutable ledger must ultimately govern all 86 Enhanced Document Intelligence Profiles; this compatibility matrix remains scoped to the 18 structures whose ordered section keys conflict.

foundationDependency.acceptanceRequirement: Satisfied locally on 2026-08-25 when the PrompTED owner accepted the fresh Node 22 foundation evidence in reliably-prompTED. Commit, push, pull request, hosted CI, merge, deployment and production promotion remain separate protected actions and are not implied by local acceptance.
foundationDependency.provenancePolicy: The foundation files were applied locally from the separately verified successor into the target reliably-prompTED worktree through bounded patches. This proves local placement only; it does not prove a commit, remote update, pull-request review, hosted CI, merge, deployment or production behavior.

currentTestingPolicy.transitionGate: Completion of the F0 foundation acceptance gate, separate authorization and local verification of L0.2 persistence/version boundaries, and locally verified L0.3 compatibility adapters.

l02Implementation.summary: L0.2 adds a dormant immutable ledger and generation-snapshot store, explicit legacy/captured identity seams, revision-checked artifact edit and approval RPCs, provenance-ready export metadata, and fail-closed binding controls. It does not register or activate a production ledger, transform historical keys, backfill data, or connect the shadow profiles to generation.

steps.name: Section-key authority and compatibility decision
steps.entryGate: Deterministically reproduce the 86 catalogue templates, 86 enhanced profiles, 68 exact structures and 18 conflicts from the current checkout.
steps.authorizedScope: ADR, proposed compatibility matrix, standalone validator, individual validator tests, audit and handoff evidence only.
steps.verification: Invoke the compatibility validator and its deliberate negative fixtures directly; do not add them to package scripts, CI or application workflows.
steps.exitGate: Satisfied on 2026-08-25 when the PrompTED owner approved Alternative C, the candidate canonical keys, historical aliases, split and merge policies, re-approval rules, adapter removal criteria and all four new-section decisions.

steps.name: Enhanced DIP V2 shadow restructuring
steps.entryGate: Use the reviewed Enhanced DIPs as source evidence and reuse the shared ledger vocabulary without changing the live DIPS registry.
steps.authorizedScope: Compile all 86 profiles into an isolated shadow representation with explicit inputs, clarification, section, quality, source, compatibility and export contracts.
steps.verification: Run only the focused Deno format, lint, check and test commands for the V2 shadow files; keep them unimported by live generation and unwired from workflows.
steps.exitGate: Satisfied on 2026-08-25 when the PrompTED owner approved the V2 representation and the requiredness policies for all four profile-only sections.

steps.name: Recovery Foundation Successor acceptance
steps.entryGate: The bounded successor files and required workflow-authority cleanup are applied to the clean reliably-prompTED worktree with source and target provenance recorded.
steps.authorizedScope: Local placement and verification in reliably-prompTED only. Commit, push, pull request, hosted CI, merge, deployment and production promotion remain separately authorized actions.
steps.verification: Run the foundation Node 22 and pnpm 10.33.0 focused checks and verify:web in the target worktree. Attribute the result only to the current uncommitted reliably-prompTED diff.
steps.exitGate: Satisfied locally on 2026-08-25 when the owner accepted the fresh Node 22 and pnpm 10.33.0 foundation evidence. Any commit, remote review, hosted CI, merge or production action still requires separate authorization.

steps.name: Immutable ledger persistence and versioned compatibility foundation
steps.entryGate: Satisfied on 2026-08-25: ADR-001 and V2 decisions were owner-approved, the owner accepted the fresh local F0 evidence, and then explicitly instructed Codex to proceed with L0.2.
steps.authorizedScope: Locally implement immutable ledger and benchmark identity, document and section version seams, source provenance, RLS and RPC boundaries, optimistic concurrency, replay identity and fresh-local-database proof. Live selection, adapters, backfill, application workflows and hosted mutation remain excluded.
steps.verification: Use focused schema, migration, RLS, RPC, concurrency and replay tests in the local environment; do not select V2 profiles in live generation or wire application workflows.
steps.exitGate: Satisfied locally: 24 migrations applied from scratch and 60 isolated database assertions plus 9 focused shared-contract tests passed. L0.3 remains a separate owner gate.

steps.name: Version-aware compatibility adapters and migration rehearsal
steps.entryGate: L0.2 persistence and version boundaries pass their focused local acceptance tests.
steps.authorizedScope: Implement approved adapters for representative rename, split, merge and unresolved cases; preserve source identities and rehearse idempotent migrations against synthetic local fixtures.
steps.verification: Run adapter, migration, approval-conflict, replay, repair and rollback tests individually; unsupported mappings fail closed and no model redistributes historical prose.
steps.exitGate: Every representative mapping preserves content, revisions, approvals and provenance under forward and rollback paths.

steps.name: Representative cohort shadow validation
steps.entryGate: L0.3 adapters and migration rehearsals pass individual local tests.
steps.authorizedScope: Compare current contracts with ledger validation for a concise, evidence-rich, structured-list, emotionally sensitive and high-risk representative cohort without blocking users or changing live selection.
steps.verification: Use standalone shadow comparisons and synthetic fixtures only; record false positives, missing states and compatibility gaps per template.
steps.exitGate: The owner reviews the representative cohort evidence and explicitly authorizes application workflow exercise.

steps.name: Application workflow exercise and one-cohort runtime shadow
steps.entryGate: The owner explicitly authorizes workflow exercise after L0.4 evidence is reviewable.
steps.authorizedScope: Exercise generation, clarification, save, reopen, edit, approval, repair, replay and export for one approved cohort while historical reads remain pinned.
steps.verification: Run the agreed local application workflow acceptance matrix and inspect actual local export artifacts before any CI, preview, staging or production claim.
steps.exitGate: The pilot cohort passes static, functional and workflow gates with rollback evidence and no unresolved high-severity defect.

steps.name: Cohort expansion and authoritative enforcement
steps.entryGate: L1 pilot evidence is approved and the owner authorizes cohort expansion and validator integration.
steps.authorizedScope: Expand cohort by cohort across all 86 Enhanced DIPs, then connect the single authoritative ledger validator to runtime and CI without creating a second permanent authority.
steps.verification: Each cohort must pass its individual contract tests before workflow tests; CI and runtime enforcement begin only at this gate.
steps.exitGate: All active profiles pass the agreed acceptance matrix, persisted cohorts are accounted for and every remaining bypass has an identified consumer and removal plan.

steps.name: Bypass removal and controlled release
steps.entryGate: All 86 profiles and affected historical cohorts are proven migrated or permanently version-pinned, and the owner separately authorizes each protected action.
steps.authorizedScope: Remove obsolete duplicate prompts, validators and section maps; perform reviewed CI, preview or staging gates; then request separate authorization for commit, push, PR, merge, hosted migration and deployment actions.
steps.verification: Prove exact-revision build provenance, hosted configuration, signed-in workflows, persistence, replay and inspected exports before any production-complete claim.
steps.exitGate: Controlled production evidence confirms the approved revision without deleting historical aliases still in use.
